answer_1.quote: We also investigate the ability of our JASMINE 2.7B model to generate texts from diverse domains. This includes the news, literary (i.e., poetry), and Twitter domains...
answer_1.outputs: Fluent and coherent Arabic text across standard, dialectal, and classical varieties

answer_2.quote: Perplexity (PPL) is a widely used metric that estimates how well a language model predicts a given text.

answer_4.quote: We ask annotators to assign a label from the set {human, generated} at the article level. Annotators only have a random chance to identify generations by our model.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators label each generated text as human or generated, evaluating fluency, coherence, and overall human‑likeness.
